A little about us

Rooted here. Open to everywhere.

Maison Ember began with a simple idea: cook close to the source, gather people around the kitchen, and give the evening room to unfold.

Our fire brings together small farms, coastal fishers, and the bright, generous flavours of Thailand. Nothing hurried; everything shared.
